rows.author: F057;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 15 AND 16 OF ARTICLE V OF RA NO. 10611, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "FOOD SAFETY ACT OF 2013"
rows.abstract:
Aims to address the issue regarding confusion among stakeholders in the meat processing industry - that they have to simultaneously deal with two regulatory agencies such as the National Meat Inspection Service (NMIS) under DA and the Food and Drug Administration under DOH in the manufacture of meat products.
Proposes for the following amendments:
“The DA shall be responsible . . . IN THE PROCESSING AND DISTRIBUTION OF MEAT PRODUCTS WHETHER LOCALLY PRODUCED OR IMPORTED;
The DOH shall be responsible for the safety of processed and prepackaged foods, EXCEPT PROCESSED MEAT PRODUCTS; . . .
The NMIS shall be responsible for meats AND PROCESSED MEAT PRODUCTS;”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2023-05-09

rows.author: F057;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL ECONOMIC DECENTRALIZATION PLAN TO FACILITATE FURTHER GROWTH IN ALL REGIONS OF THE PHILIPPINES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Progresibong Pilipinas Para sa Lahat ng Pilipino Act
Seeks to create a Phil. Decentralization Committee to be chaired by the Executive Secretary with Secretaries of DPWH, DOF, DBM, DOTr, Director General of NEDA, Representatives from the League of Governors/ Cities, and experts from the private sector and the academe in several fields of expertise like urban planning and 7853management, supply chain management, and agro-business and industrial growth.
Proposes several provisions, among others, regarding the following:  
a) periodic comprehensive studies focusing on challenges/opportunities for regional economic development; b) healthcare development program (establishment of Heart/Lung/Orthopedic Centers, Kidney Institute); c) Regional Centers of Excellence (education and skills development through DepEd, CHED, TESDA); d) relocation of National Government Agencies to enhance the delivery of goods and services; e) decentralization of procurement procedures for major NGA projects;  f) tax incentives for industries outside NCR; and g) appropriations and periodic implementation.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN AGRICULTURE INFORMATION SYSTEM IN ALL CITIES AND
MUNICIPALITIES
rows.abstract:
Proposes the establishment of a computer database that shall contain an up-to-date inventory of all agricultural commodities available in the various local communities.

Intends for AIS to serve as a database where information on the demand for specific agricultural commodities is gathered simultaneously with the production data from farmers in every barangay and shall serve as the platform for marketing agricultural products nationwide.

Aims to facilitate the free registration of all farmers, fisherfolk, and buyers transacting within their respective area in the system; to mandate the LGUs to consolidate all pertinent data on the profile and demographics as farmers and buyers and to store these in the respective AIS.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-05-29, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-05-30 and received by the Senate on 2023-05-30

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO RATIONALIZE THE PHILIPPINE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT SYSTEM, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to rationalize the 1978 PD 1586 (Phil. Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) System, to resolve disagreements among project proponents, agencies, NGOs, and other stakeholders resulting from differences in the interpretation of the law.
Proposes to require an Environmental Impact Assessment for specific projects - critical projects (CPs) or projects which have the potential to cause a significant adverse impact on the environment (heavy industries, major manufacturing industries, major resource extractive industries, major infrastructure projects, and others.
Proposes that micro-, small- and medium-scale projects -  be governed by local governments to integrate environmental safeguards in local permitting systems and/or complementary environmental assessment policies.
Provides for programmatic EIA for a cluster of projects co-located in an area such as industrial estates, export processing zones, small-scale mining, livestock, aquaculture, and mariculture projects, . . .
rows.status: Substituted by HB11093

AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 17, CHAPTER V, TITLE I, BOOK III AND SECTION 27,
CHAPTER V, TITLE I (A), BOOK V OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 292 OR THE
ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987
rows.abstract:
Amends some provisions, among others, to be read as follows:
SEC.1 Sec. 17. Power to Issue Temporary Designation. - 
(1)	The President may temporarily designate an officer already in the government service, appointment to which is vested in him by law, . . .
(2)	. . .
(3)	In no case shall a temporary designation exceed SIX (6) MONTHS. IN CASE OF VACANCY, THE PRESIDENT IS MANDATED TO FILL THE POSITION WITH A PERMANENT APPOINTMENT WITHIN THE SAID PERIOD.
SEC. 2. Sec. 27. Employment Status  - Appointment in the career service shall be permanent or temporary.
x x x
        (2)  Temporary appointment. -  . . .
PROVIDED FURTHER, THAT ON OR BEFORE THE EXPIRATION OF THE SIX-MONTH PERIOD FROM THE TIME OF VACANCY, A PERSON ISSUED WITH A PERMANENT APPOINTMENT SHALL FILL THE SAID VACANCY. 
A PERSON DESIGNATED AS AN OFFICER-IN-CHARGE (OIC) SHALL EXERCISE LIMITED POWERS WHICH ARE CONFINED ONLY TO FUNCTIONS OF ADMINISTRATION . . . THE OIC SHALL NOT BE DEEMED TO POSSESS POWERS INVOLVING THE EXERCISE OF DISCRETION TO ENTER INTO ANY LONG-TERM AND/OR HIGH-VALUE CONTRACTS OR AGREEMENTS . . .

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE CONVERGENCE STRATEGY FOR SUSTAINABLE RURAL DEVELOPMENT AND PROVIDING THE IMPLEMENTING MECHANISMS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Aims for the convergence of resources and expertise of NGAs (Departments of Agriculture/Agrarian Reform/Natural Resources, and the Department of Interior and Local Government) which shall work with national line agencies and GOCCs (NEA, NIA, and NFA), the academe, donor agencies, NGOs, POs, the rural community, and other relevant stakeholders - to develop a sustainable development plan, institutionalizing the National Convergence Initiative for Sustainable Rural Development (NCI-SRD).

Provides that NCI-SRD shall promote integrated ecosystem management - taking into consideration the conservation, restoration, and protection of natural ecosystems and resources from ridge to reef.
Proposes among others, for a defined constituency that shall focus on smallholder farmers, both agrarian reform beneficiaries (ARBs), and non-ARB, small fisherfolk, upland dwellers, and Indigenous Peoples (IPs); and for relevant measures for an enabling environment to encourage investment by the private sector, cooperatives and other NGOs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on RURAL DEVELOPMENT since 2023-05-15
